title: France’s Senate Rejects Rule Forcing Bitcoin Holders to Declare Self-Custody Wallets
summary: Bitcoin Magazine France’s Senate Rejects Rule Forcing Bitcoin Holders to Declare Self-Custody Wallets France's Senate rejected amendments that would have forced holders to declare self-custody crypto wallets worth €100,000 or more, along with stablecoin and exit tax measures. This post France’s Senate Rejects Rule Forcing Bitcoin Holders to Declare Self-Custody Wallets first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
